notes.title: Update 1.05, Minor Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug "R" isn't respawning character to save point.
Added a different color for the puzzles in the end-game-display room when finishing "Difficult" in Bullet room.
Added a bit hints for one of the achievement in game.

notes.title: Update 1.04, Minor Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where you may not be able to obtain achievement when completing difficult level

notes.title: Update 1.03, Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Version 13th June 2025	
	Added Reset button
	For keyboard, press the R key. 
	For controller, press RB and Left Face Button at the same time (i.e. the X key on the Xbox Controller).
	
	Interface
	In the game's Settings, a Quit Game button has been added
	Health indicator is now always in the upper left corner
	Button indicator is now always in the upper right corner
	Button indicator will now show more button
	The above indicator will disappear after 8.0 seconds without moving/getting hurt/using mana
	Tutorial Zoom-In have been added near some important but small Tutorial Board
	
	Bug
	Fixed the problem that the text on the background image was not converted to the set language every time the game was entered
	Fixed the problem that the job name was typed incorrectly on the title screen
	Fixed the problem that the background music might be canceled when there are too many sound effects
